description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Galpayayage Don Trimal Sampath as a member of the Palindanuwara P/S. Elected Mr. Kumbalakara Arachchige Premawardana as a member of the Bulathsinhala P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to member deaths, following electoral procedures under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies, which falls under electoral processes and related matters - the core focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
